about: A torch: a stick with a wrapped, burning head. Carried for light in either hand, beside a one-hander; a poor club.

hands.source: assets/data/items.ron, the torch's hold.grip; carried: true, so it counts as nothing in the stance (holding.md)

lead.source: D460 and D463: the hand whose slot holds it, main or off, mirrored on a left-handed body; Carry_Torch serves either hand (attachment.md Carried)

grip_type.source: D562: in hand, a power grip closed by touch on the stick

slots.name: head
slots.joins: its socket (the wrap's bore: socket.mouth and socket.bottom on the stick's line); the stick made to them, its top at socket.bottom

slots.name: stick
slots.joins: a round stick along +Y from its butt

slots.name: binding
slots.joins: its bore on the stick, under the head (a cord or iron band)

grip.how: on the stick, grip_from_end up from its butt (the reference's 0.10 m; D546's hafted 0.04 to 0.12): the item's origin

edge.how: the head's flame point (where the fire sits, on its line) carried through, for the light; as a club, the head's span along +Y

open.why: torchlight.rs places the flame by its own number today; reading it from the head's point comes with the assembler (step 2)

held.how: a carried item has no ready pose: in either hand it is always in its carry pose, flame up and ahead (holding.md: carried counts as nothing)

used.how: it lights the way while in hand (items.ron tool.lights); a blow plays the walker's Sword_Attack (items.ron tool.strikes 5.0)

carried.how: on a raised arm, flame up and ahead, its handle within 2.2 degrees of up and 10 cm clear of the body in every carried clip on every template (attachment.md Carried); not tipped by the rule

stowed.how: put out and hung at the hip (D567), D551's one-handed hafted row: on the main hand's side

open.why: putting the flame and its light out when stowed, and the turn and offset on the socket (attachment.md Stowed's next step), are not built

blocking.how: a carried item counts as nothing in the stance (holding.md), so it never blocks

animation.how: no move set: a carried item only lays its arm's pose (holding.md's carried), Carry_Torch (art/animation/sets/fight.json)

length_m.source: assets/data/items.ron hold.length; the look's bounds measured 0.550

open.why: items.ron gives the whole torch only; the head's share is its part's, weighed when made

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

grip_diameter_m.source: a torch stick about 4 cm across (recalled); measured on the reference's stick when made

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15, for its blow: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

length_m.source: the reference's length ±10% (research/2026-10-28-assembled-items-animation.md section 1); Carry_Torch holds it upright, so its clearance is checked across this band

open.why: the head's reference mass is open (above); for the whole torch the band is 0.45 to 0.83 kg at its balance

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and length, solved for the balance

envelope.state: computed from items.ron's stand-in; the carry pose's clearance measured on the one look only
